## How it was made

Standard v1 ([docs/PIPELINE.md](../../../docs/PIPELINE.md)): measured to scale, re-rendered straight
and clean from a photo, every printed label checked.
Body aspect 0.3618 (spec 0.3615), screen at the exact 240:320 aspect.

**Credits:** appearance from a [photo](https://5.imimg.com/data5/LN/DO/BC/SELLER-89654178/sony-ericsson-walkman-w595-floral--500x500.jpg (press render, via Koks; front cropped)); geometry measured on a [photo](https://gsm.magazyn.pl/pic/b/sony-ericsson-w595.jpg); specs: [teltarif.de](https://www.teltarif.de/h/sony-ericsson/w595/), [en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sony_Ericsson_W595).
